$comment: First-load JavaScript per route, in kilobytes, measured as the decoded
bytes a browser downloads on a cold load of the standalone production
build. Uncompressed: what ships over the wire is smaller, but this is the
number that tracks what was added, and it does not move when compression
settings do.
Measured rather than read out of Next's build output. The size columns are
gone from `next build` in 16.x and the manifests underneath are
undocumented internals that move between versions; what the browser
downloads is what the budget is about, and it survives the bundler being
replaced.
The numbers below are the 2026-09-06 measurements plus ~15%. Read the
shape before trusting the granularity: every authenticated route measured
the same 706.4 kB, because the shared app shell dominates and per-route
code is lost in it. Only two routes differ — /login, which renders before
the shell exists, and the flow detail route, which loads the React Flow
canvas. So this is close to a shell budget with two exceptions, and it
will catch a heavy new dependency long before it catches a heavy new page.
Making it genuinely per-route means splitting the shell, which is a
performance change, not a test change.
Raising a budget is a decision, not a formality: say in the commit message
what got bigger and why it earns its place.
Raised 2026-09-13: /offers and /creatives 820 -> 880, /decision-flows
820 -> 850, the flow detail route 1010 -> 1030. Not for shell growth —
that was the first guess, and measurement showed the shell grew 0.8 kB.
The reason is the descriptor registry (40 kB) and the panel registry with
the list-detail host (54 kB), each loaded whole by every route that touches
either (G-111). Splitting them is W-080, proposed as its own slice.
The paragraph above about the shell is also only partly true. These
numbers include what Next prefetches for a route's visible links: 95 to
250 kB per route, measured with scripts/measure-route-payload.mjs
--prefetch both. A route's budget therefore includes the screens it links
to, and /decision-flows failed on screens it links to, not its own 13 kB
